newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-NORMA NEW PROFIT FORECAST 97.1 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-NORMA NEW PROFIT FORECAST 97.1 MLN.

text.p: Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, said on Tuesday that it will raise its 1997 profit forecast to 97.1 million kroons from its previous estimate of 50.2 million kroons.
In a statement the company said its management also approved a new turnover estimate of 486.8 million kroons.

The company said that the revised estimate was based on results from the first half of 1997 and the expectation that the company's main market would remain on the same level as in the first half of 1997.
